4. [IRET.23.4] **Refraction table implementation: a
   generation-stamped array.** Each terminal's table
   ([IRET.11.3]) is an open-addressing array of entries
   (token hash, generation, fact-id tuple), probed
   linearly. An entry stamped with an earlier generation
   counts as empty, so a generation's turnover empties the
   table in O(1) without visiting it, which `oa`'s
   per-entry delete ([IRET.28]) cannot. It and the intern
   table ([IRET.1.4]) are the two Rete tables that are not
   `oa` tables. The edge-once set ([IRET.11.3.5]) is an
   `oa` set keyed by fact id.
